cards.signin: {{cast.user}} signs in to {{cast.company}} in the store's own page, driven through PingOne's API.
cards.pkce: A code meant for {{cast.agent}} is worthless to anyone who lacks {{cast.agent}}'s verifier.
cards.par: {{cast.agent}} pushes the order request to PingOne before the user sees anything.
cards.jar: {{cast.agent}} signs its sign-in request, so a tampered request is refused.
cards.clientCredentials: At {{cast.company}}, the {{cast.serviceWord}} gets its own token to talk to the warehouse, with no shopper involved.
cards.lifecycle: {{cast.agent}}'s shopping session is refreshed, checked and then revoked when {{cast.user}} signs out everywhere.
cards.userinfo: {{cast.agent}} reads {{cast.user}}'s profile from PingOne with {{cast.user}}'s own token.
cards.device: {{cast.user}} signs in to the in-store screen by typing a code on a phone.
cards.ciba: {{cast.agent}} found a deal but needs {{cast.user}}'s yes; PingOne asks {{cast.user}} out of band.
cards.tokenExchange: {{cast.user}}'s token is exchanged so {{cast.agent}} can act for {{cast.user}}, and the new token says so.
cards.piflow: {{cast.company}}'s checkout renders the sign-in steps from PingOne's JSON.
